Hand-written fixtures in the shape returned by the SignalWarden `/api/v1/worldview-gpsjam` relay
(verified against live gpsjam.org files on 2026-10-31). The H3 res-4 cell ids are real indices
(Gdańsk, Riga, Tallinn, Cyprus, west Texas, New York, two antimeridian cells and an H3 pentagon);
every aircraft count is invented for tests. No GPSJAM data is bundled.
